title: Booking for two riders
_dead_note: The capture opens and closes on the macOS wallpaper, with white flash frames between it and the app. Scene 1 starts at 2.37s and the last scene ends at 99.97s, so no junk is inside any segment. The MASTER is untouched.
_frames_note: `frames` on each scene is its own footage at 30fps — the rate was MEASURED, never assumed 25.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Two riders, one booking. Enter your email for a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add the first rider.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection and choose your own bike. The size and the colour are picked right here on the row, before you check the dates.

scenes.label: first-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day you collect it, then the day you bring it back.

scenes.label: party-members
scenes.line: Now invite the second rider to the same order.

scenes.label: member-two-added
scenes.line: They are on the order too.

scenes.label: second-catalogue
scenes.line: Choose their bike the same way, size and colour on the row.

scenes.label: second-dates
scenes.line: Their dates go on their own calendar, so you need not match.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now the questions, one set per rider. Age and height for you, then the same for them on their own card. We set every frame and saddle from these numbers. Then agree to the terms for both of you, and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: One payment covers the whole order.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Both bikes sit under this one booking in your history.
